# `/password-change-status` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /password-change-status/v1/{id}

`getPasswordChangeStatusV1` — Get password change request status

This API returns the status of a password change request.

- Scopes: idn:password-change:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Password change request ID
- Returns 200: passwordstatus
